'''Chicken salad''' is very similar in many respects to [[Cookbook:Tuna Salad|tuna salad]], although there are many variations on the dish which can set it apart. Chicken salad tends to work well with sweet fruit and vegetable flavors, and is ideal for lunch-time sandwiches.

== Ingredients ==
*4 skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken breast|chicken breasts]]
*2 stalks [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Pepper|peppercorns]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Bay Leaf|bay leaves]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 cup [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
*1 cup mango [[:Category:Chutney recipes|chutney]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

== Procedure ==
# Add the chicken breasts to a small pot. Add enough water to cover.
# [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] stalks of celery into large sticks. Add celery, bay leaves, teaspoon salt, and peppercorns to the pot. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Once boiling, lower temperature and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]] for at least one hour. Chicken should be tender, and should pull apart easily.
# Remove chicken from water. You may wish to reserve the water as a base for a stock or a soup.
# Slice chicken into small bite-size cubes. Take care not to shred the chicken, because the salad should be chunky.
# Put cut chicken into a medium-sized bowl. Add mayonnaise and chutney, one spoonful at a time until salad reaches correct consistency. The salad should be moist and chunky, not wet and mushy. Add salt and pepper to taste.
# Serve by itself in a bowl, or on bread, biscuits, or croissants.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
*Dice a half-stick of celery into fine pieces, and add to the salad.
*Add a cut of sliced seedless grapes to the salad for extra sweetness.
*Dice a [[Cookbook:Hard Cooked Eggs|hard-boiled egg]] and add to the salad.
*Top with cranberry sauce, orange marmalade, or spicy brown mustard.
